survey: A tall drinking glass of orange iced drink stands upright on a purple tabletop, seen from slightly above the front. It has a thick clear base, and its soft shadow falls to the left, so it is sitting on the surface. A pink bendy straw goes in at the upper left of the rim. Its bend sits above the glass, and the straight part runs at an angle through the liquid almost to the bottom, refracted where you would expect. A cyan paper cocktail umbrella on a wooden stick leans out over the right side of the rim, with its stick going down into the drink. Ice cubes fill the glass: one pokes above the surface at the top and others sit packed in the liquid below it, which fits a full glass of ice. Small bubbles rise near the bottom. Every part attaches or rests where it should.
